rootCause.summary: The DB connection pool ran out after commit abc123 lowered the pool size to 5.

rubric.text: Names connection pool exhaustion as the cause
Links the cause to commit abc123 or the 10:05 deploy
Proposes restoring the pool size or rolling back

report.reason: The logs show timeouts acquiring a DB connection from 10:10, when p99 latency rose above 2s.
report.summary: Checkout is slow because it runs out of DB connections.
report.cause: The DB connection pool is exhausted, so requests wait for a connection and time out. Why it started is not clear; traffic looks normal.

findings.claim: From 10:10 the logs show timeouts acquiring a connection from the pool.

fixes.title: Raise the pool size
fixes.detail: Raise the DB pool size until the timeouts stop.
